description: Recommends four-year pilot funding for SREDA's Business Hub.
Funded from Property Realization Reserve; other requests to budget.
Explore SREDA, Discover Saskatoon governance reforms by Q3 2026.

chips.text: The Centralized Business Hub aims to help local businesses navigate city processes.
Dale Botting, a citizen and former SREDA CEO, suggested more creative funding options.

speakers.name: Erin Lawson
speakers.summary: Registered to speak on: Economic Development Funding in Saskatoon
said: Proposal does not include incentives or civic policy tools.
Low unemployment challenges hiring and attracting new investment.
Proposes talent attraction/retention strategy to meet workforce needs.

speakers.name: Dale Botting
speakers.summary: Registered to speak on: Economic Development Funding
said: Current debate is too narrow; suggests more creative options.
SREDA should explore more own-source revenues, like membership growth.
Province of Saskatchewan should increase its economic development contribution.

description: Audit finds city's risk management program is at level two.
Recommends improvements to reach a target level four.
Administration will develop a strategy by end of 2025.

chips.text: City Auditor explained target maturity level four is model-derived, not an administration goal.
Many audit recommendations will begin implementation in early 2026, continuing into 2027.

segments.title: City Auditor presents risk management audit results
segments.takeaway: The City Auditor presented the audit findings, assessing the city's risk management program maturity as "repeatable" (level two) with IT tools at "initial" (level one).

segments.title: Questions on audit scope and maturity targets
segments.takeaway: Committee members questioned the audit's scope, focusing on policies rather than effectiveness, and discussed the target maturity level of four for the program.

segments.title: Administration's plan for audit recommendations
segments.takeaway: Administration confirmed they are not starting from scratch and are integrating audit recommendations into an ERM strategy, with implementation expected over the next few years.

segments.title: Risk Management Program Audit item concluded
segments.takeaway: With no further questions or comments from the committee, the Risk Management Program Audit report was received as information.
